Japanese.hint: 着いたら靴を履き替える必要があるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Review service charges and gratuity line items on final spa bill
tasks.hint: Check line items on bill before paying.
tasks.done_when: Learner reviewed service charges and gratuity on final spa bill.
tasks.scene_hint: Fresh orchids adorn polished stone reception desks.

Japanese.goal: 最終的な請求書のサービス料とチップの項目を確認する
Japanese.hint: 支払う前に請求書の各項目を確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request an itemized receipt for health insurance wellness reimbursement
tasks.hint: Ask for detailed receipt for insurance claim.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested itemized receipt for health insurance reimbursement.

Japanese.goal: 健康保険の補助を申請するために明細付きの領収書をお願いする
Japanese.hint: 保険の請求に使う詳しい領収書がほしいと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask receptionist to book a follow-up massage appointment for next month
tasks.hint: Schedule your next massage session.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked receptionist to book follow-up massage for next month.

Japanese.goal: 来月の次回マッサージの予約を受付にお願いする
Japanese.hint: 次のマッサージの予約を入れましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about purchasing retail facial serums used during treatment
tasks.hint: Ask to buy the facial serum used by therapist.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about purchasing retail facial serums used in treatment.

Japanese.goal: 施術で使ったフェイシャル美容液を購入したいと尋ねる
Japanese.hint: セラピストが使った美容液を買いたいと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm payment using gift voucher balance before departing
tasks.hint: Verify voucher balance covered treatment cost.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed payment using gift voucher balance before departing.

Japanese.goal: 帰る前にギフト券の残高で支払いが済んだか確認する
Japanese.hint: ギフト券の残高で施術料金がまかなえたか確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the spa receptionist and therapist for a relaxing experience
tasks.hint: Express gratitude to spa staff before leaving.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked receptionist and therapist for a relaxing experience.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft lit payment desk features herbal tea samples and appointment cards.

Japanese.goal: リラックスできたことについて受付の人とセラピストにお礼を言う
Japanese.hint: 帰る前にスパのスタッフに感謝の気持ちを伝えましょう。

name_translations.Japanese: スパ＆マッサージの予約

place_translations.Japanese: 落ち着いた雰囲気のスパの受付
